mechanics.claim: Final Spark fires a beam in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.
mechanics.quote: fires a massive light beam in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: The ability has a spell shield interaction, meaning a single instance of damage can be blocked as one spell.
The damage is dealt as an area-of-effect line, not a projectile with travel time.
